Team Cetarchon:
Give Cetarchon Crimson Pulse CoV. Switch Celeste for Ramona so we dont overlap Awakeners, and have her run Keyflare WoDs. You’re running and mix of Aequor Tawil and Cetarchon which is two carries, but its ok early. Later you lean into one or the other because Arithma and they don’t exactly synergies. 

Team Cantena:
Give Celeste a complete CoV set, and Aigis the Scarlet Embrace or Deus Ex Machina. 

———————

There is SR Purple WoDs called “Critical Point” and “Hand of Oblivion” which you should replace on Cantena and Cetarchon’s WoDs. The “To My Dearest Friend” can be placed on Caecus for Exalt Vuln Burst turn. 

Aigis, Ramona, Thais, Tawil(sometimes) likes Keyflare WoDs.

Caecus, Celeste can run anything/support WoDs.

Cetarchon and Cantena like “Strike Do More Dmg” WoDs and classic Crit Dmg + Crit Rate, and Dmg Amp if the no more Crit WoDs. Some people run DPS Tawil.

Aigis, Ogier, Kathigua-Ra, Doll or Hameln.

Kath is damage dealer. Aigis is Vuln + Keyfalre + Stun. Ogier is Shielding and STR Gen for Kath BOOM! Doll can apply Weakness to survive, or Hameln can STR Gen(kinda). Hamlen Rouse can technically help you scale STR by double playing his 3 cost, which gives more draw and Arith too(technically).
